description: Extract Reviews / Pros & Cons / Q&A text from a theresanaiforthat.com product detail page. Content is all in the DOM (tabs are anchors), so one Runtime.evaluate reads all three sections (reviews scoped to comment bodies) into scalar variables. Persistence (record_extraction) is a harness post-step.

steps.purpose: Open the TAAFT product detail page in the SAME reused tab (avoids fresh-tab Cloudflare; re-navigating a warm tab keeps clearance). onError:continue — a heavy real page makes the navigate CALL return -32001 timeout while the page actually loads; the next listen Page.loaded settles it.

params.expression: function chl(){var t=(document.title||'').toLowerCase();var u=(location.href||'').toLowerCase();var m=['just a moment','verify you are human','checking your browser','attention required','cloudflare','cf-chl','__cf_chl','challenge-platform'];var hit=m.some(function(s){return t.indexOf(s)>=0||u.indexOf(s)>=0;});return {challenge:hit?'yes':''};}return chl();

steps.purpose: Detect a Cloudflare/CAPTCHA challenge by title/url markers (challengeFlag='yes' only when challenged; empty on the happy path)
Dismiss the auth/signup overlay if present (harmless when absent)

params.expression: function bh(t){var hs=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('h1,h2,h3,h4,[role=heading]'));return hs.find(function(h){return h.textContent.trim().toLowerCase().indexOf(t.toLowerCase())===0;});}function box(h){if(!h)return null;var el=h;for(var i=0;i<5&&el.parentElement;i++){el=el.parentElement;if((el.innerText||'').length>600)return el;}return el;}function bt(h){var b=box(h);return b?(b.innerText||''):'';}function reviews(){var b=box(bh('Reviews'));if(!b)return '';var cs=[].slice.call(b.querySelectorAll('.comment_content, .comment_body'));if(cs.length){return cs.map(function(e){return (e.innerText||'').trim();}).filter(Boolean).join('\n---\n');}var c=b.cloneNode(true);var rc=c.querySelector('.ratings_chart_outer');if(rc)rc.remove();return (c.innerText||'').trim();}return {reviews:reviews().slice(0,2500),pros:bt(bh('Pros')).slice(0,2000),qa:bt(bh('Q&A')).slice(0,2000)};

steps.purpose: Read Reviews (scoped to comment bodies) / Pros&Cons / Q&A via a return-body script that locates each section by heading
